recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. Future changes should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack unless OO explicitly decides to promote the concept to a core DiagnosticReport element.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification R5 issue asking to keep DiagnosticReport.status as report status and add a repeatable DiagnosticReport workflow-status extension with CodeableConcept value and instant timestamp for imaging workflow history.
initial_application: The Jira application comment points to HL7/fhir-extensions commit a0be181289ba4f5c07a1b0533b9b21c2300f3dce, which created input/definitions/DiagnosticReport/StructureDefinition-diagnosticReport-workflowStatus.xml. No core FHIR commit tagged FHIR-25995 was found.
additional_context: OO minutes show the work group first considered Task/workflow handling in 2020, then on 2023-02-10 voted to try a DiagnosticReport extension for R5 STU rather than add a new core element. Current Extension Pack source contains the requested DiagnosticReport-scoped complex extension.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined core branch. No core source files were changed because the maintained source of truth for the requested artifact is in the FHIR Extension Pack.

related_jiras.note: Mentioned in the same OO minutes as nearby DiagnosticReport workflow/summary discussion, but it is a separate tracker and was not needed to decide FHIR-25995.
